017package org.apache.juneau.marshall.parser;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.AssertionUtils.*;
020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.IoUtils.*;
021import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.SystemUtils.*;
022
023import java.nio.charset.*;
024
025import org.apache.juneau.commons.collections.*;
026import org.apache.juneau.marshall.*;
027
028/**
029 * Subclass of {@link Parser} for character-based parsers.
030 *
031 * <h5 class='topic'>Description</h5>
032 * <p>
033 * This class is typically the parent class of all character-based parsers.
034 * It has 1 abstract method to implement on the session object...
035 * <ul>
036 *    <li>{@link ParserSession#doRead(ParserPipe, ClassMeta)}
037 * </ul>
038 *
039 * <h5 class='section'>Notes:</h5><ul>
040 *    <li class='note'>This class is thread safe and reusable.
041 * </ul>
042 *
043 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
044 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/SerializersAndParsers">Serializers and Parsers</a>
045 * </ul>
046 */
047@SuppressWarnings({
048   "java:S115" // Constants use UPPER_snakeCase convention
049})
050public class ReaderParser extends Parser {
051
052   // Property name constants
053   private static final String PROP_streamCharset = "streamCharset";
054
055   // Argument name constants for assertArgNotNull
056   private static final String ARG_copyFrom = "copyFrom";
057
058   /**
059    * Builder class.
060    */
061   @SuppressWarnings({
062      "java:S119" // 'SELF' (CRTP self-type) is intentional and clearer than a single-letter name.
063   })
064   public abstract static class Builder<SELF extends Builder<SELF>> extends Parser.Builder<SELF> {
065
066      private Charset streamCharset;
067
068      /**
069       * Constructor, default settings.
070       */
071      protected Builder() {
072         streamCharset = env("ReaderParser.streamCharset", UTF8);
073      }
074
075      /**
076       * Copy constructor.
077       *
078       * @param copyFrom The builder to copy from.
079       *    <br>Cannot be <jk>null</jk>.
080       */
081      protected Builder(Builder<?> copyFrom) {
082         super(assertArgNotNull(ARG_copyFrom, copyFrom));
083         streamCharset = copyFrom.streamCharset;
084      }
085
086      /**
087       * Copy constructor.
088       *
089       * @param copyFrom The bean to copy from.
090       *    <br>Cannot be <jk>null</jk>.
091       */
092      protected Builder(ReaderParser copyFrom) {
093         super(assertArgNotNull(ARG_copyFrom, copyFrom));
094         streamCharset = copyFrom.streamCharset;
095      }
096
097      @Override /* Overridden from Context.Builder<?> */
098      public ReaderParser build() {
099         return build(ReaderParser.class);
100      }
101
102      @Override /* Overridden from Context.Builder<?> */
103      public abstract SELF copy();
104
105      @Override /* Overridden from Context.Builder<?> */
106      public HashKey hashKey() {
107         // @formatter:off
108         return HashKey.of(
109            super.hashKey(),
110            streamCharset
111         );
112         // @formatter:on
113      }
114
115      /**
116       * Input stream charset.
117       *
118       * <p>
119       * The character set to use for converting <c>InputStreams</c> and byte arrays to readers.
120       *
121       * <p>
122       * Used when passing in input streams and byte arrays to {@link Parser#read(Object, Class)}.
123       *
124       * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
125       * <p class='bjava'>
126       *    <jc>// Create a parser that reads UTF-8 files.</jc>
127       *    ReaderParser <jv>parser</jv> = JsonParser
128       *       .<jsm>create</jsm>()
129       *       .streamCharset(Charset.<jsm>forName</jsm>(<js>"UTF-8"</js>))
130       *       .build();
131       *
132       *    <jc>// Use it to read a UTF-8 encoded input stream.</jc>
133       *    MyBean <jv>myBean</jv> = <jv>parser</jv>.read(<jk>new</jk> FileInputStream(<js>"MyBean.txt"</js>), MyBean.<jk>class</jk>);
134       * </p>
135       *
136       * @param value
137       *    The new value for this property.
138       *    <br>The default value is <js>"UTF-8"</js>.
139       *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (defaults to UTF-8).
140       * @return This object.
141       */
142      public SELF streamCharset(Charset value) {
143         streamCharset = value;
144         return self();
145      }
146
147
148   }
149
150   /**
151    * Concrete default builder leaf for the non-subclassed {@link ReaderParser#create()} / {@link ReaderParser#copy()} path.
152    */
153   public static final class DefaultBuilder extends Builder<DefaultBuilder> {
154
155      DefaultBuilder() {}
156
157      DefaultBuilder(ReaderParser copyFrom) {
158         super(copyFrom);
159      }
160
161      DefaultBuilder(Builder<?> copyFrom) {
162         super(copyFrom);
163      }
164
165      @Override /* Overridden from Context.Builder<?> */
166      public DefaultBuilder copy() {
167         return new DefaultBuilder(this);
168      }
169   }
170
171   /**
172    * Creates a new builder for this object.
173    *
174    * @return A new builder.
175    */
176   @SuppressWarnings({
177      "java:S1452" // Builder<?> wildcard return intentional; callers chain via fluent API without needing the concrete type
178   })
179   public static Builder<?> create() {
180      return new DefaultBuilder();
181   }
182
183   private final Charset streamCharset;
184
185   /**
186    * Constructor.
187    *
188    * @param builder The builder for this object.
189    *    <br>Cannot be <jk>null</jk>.
190    */
191   protected ReaderParser(Builder<?> builder) {
192      super(builder);
193      streamCharset = builder.streamCharset;
194   }
195
196   @Override /* Overridden from Context */
197   public ReaderParserSession.Builder<?> createSession() {
198      return ReaderParserSession.create(this);
199   }
200
201   @Override /* Overridden from Context */
202   public ReaderParserSession getSession() { return createSession().build(); }
203
204   @Override /* Overridden from Parser */
205   public final boolean isReaderParser() { return true; }
206
207   /**
208    * Input stream charset.
209    *
210    * @see Builder#streamCharset(Charset)
211    * @return
212    *    The character set to use for converting <c>InputStreams</c> and byte arrays to readers.
213    */
214   protected final Charset getStreamCharset() { return streamCharset; }
215
216   @Override /* Overridden from Parser */
217   protected FluentMap<String,Object> properties() {
218      return super.properties()
219         .a(PROP_streamCharset, streamCharset);
220   }
221}
